checkRuns.command:
rm -rf .tmp-test && bun remove happy-dom @happy-dom/global-registrator 2>&1 | tail -1; cat package.json | sed -n '/devDep/,/}/p'
kill %1 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "bun server.js"; sleep 0.5
bun run check 2>&1 | tail -2 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -2
pgrep -af "server.js" ; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -1 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -2

docs.source: https://svelte.dev/llms.txt and the files it links
